india_trends.title: SBI chief CS Setty expects further 50 bps rate hikes in December, rules out retail loan quality concerns
india_trends.summary: SBI Chairman CS Setty expects interest rates to rise by 0.50% points in December, then pause in Feb 2027. Higher rates could curb discretionary spending and consumer credit, but are unlikely to damage retail loan quality, with projected 7.1% economic growth supporting productive sectors, he noted.

india_trends.title: Global Market: European shares flat as investors assess earnings, France turmoil
india_trends.summary: European shares traded flat as investors weighed corporate earnings and political uncertainty in France. Falling oil prices, driven by hopes of easing US-Iran tensions, supported travel and leisure stocks, while energy shares declined.

india_trends.title: Mind-boggling Monday at Indian stock markets: Sensex, Nifty mirror life’s ups and downs — October 26 trade details
india_trends.summary: The Nifty 50 opened lower at 22,524, and the sell-off accelerated at the opening bell, dragging the index towards 22,387 before it staged a sharp recovery. Supported by gains in financial stocks, the index closed 0.68% higher at 22,735. The Sensex also ended the session 0.66% higher at 73,606.

india_trends.title: Ather Energy shares skyrocket 19% after EV maker swings to Rs 1.26 crore profit in Q2
india_trends.summary: Ather Energy shares surged nearly 19% after the electric two-wheeler maker reported a net profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27, reversing a loss of Rs 154 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 62.8% year-on-year to Rs 1,464 crore, while the company also approved Rs 122 crore in capacity expansion.
